title: Output heatmap is zeros
body: Hi I m trying to train a structure similar to Openpose but with only two additional stages no PAF branch depth image from RealSense as input and only 3 keypoints I only need both hands and face for my application so the output is a batch h 8 w 8 3 stack The training is done with Keras I ve got only around 5000 training images but with some extensive augmentation The ground truth is appropriately scaled heatmaps with Gaussian peaks in place of keaypoints I notice that the output heatmap is basically always just a matrix of zeros immediately after the first 2 3 iterations Nothing on it Up until now I ve only had enough patience to let it run for about 1500 iterations more than a day on two GPUs and the loss basically always stays around the same value with the output being just zeros Do you think I might be doing something fundamentally wrong or do I just have to have enough patience to wait for 300 000 iterations just like in your original implementation By the way when you talk about iterations do you mean epochs or epochs steps per epoch

comments.body: Hi I am facing a similar issue with almost the same setting as yours Did you solve the problem after that

Hi I am facing a similar issue with almost the same setting as yours Did you solve the problem after that Hi yeah I d switched to the SGD optimizer using an initial learning rate of 2e 5 and a ReduceLROnPlateau callback made the Gaussian peaks for the keypoints a bit larger added many more training samples and just generally waited for the training to run a bit longer I was able to see acceptable results already after a thousand epochs My settings optimizer sgd SGD lr 2e 05 decay 0 0 momentum 0 9 nesterov False loss function def heat loss x y return K sum K square x y 2 compiling model model compile optimizer sgd loss heat loss callback from keras callbacks import ReduceLROnPlateau reduce learning rate ReduceLROnPlateau monitor loss factor gamma patience 50 verbose 1 Hope that helps
Hi Xonxt Thank you so much You saved my day I switched from Adam to SGD and reduced the kernel size from 7 to 3 in all convolutional layers Everything started to work

rocketbear Hi you said the training error converges to 200 quickly I would like to know the training error you said is the total loss of the stage1 to stage 6 and the total loss of L1 and L2 loss Another question is about the backbone feature extraction layers and the additional cpm layers You said The convergence problem is solved by using residual connections all through the model i e in both the backbone feature extraction layers and the additional cpm layers FYI The backbone feature extraction model you chose is the DenseNet or the mobileNet I have tried the mobileNet for training the faster and smaller model but it doesn t work and the loss is as high as 1000 of total 6 stages Furthermore about the additional cpm layers during my training and testing the cpm branch can work well the paf can not work well and always trends toward to disconvergence I mean would you mind sharing the additional cpm layers design and how do you deal with the paf branch keeping it as the original Thanks looking forward to your kindness answers
rocketbear and would you mind asking us how fast about your model

The goal of my work is to train a much faster model with user acceptable accuracy on our own data Since there are only a few difficult poses in our data I decide to significantly reduce the model size So my model has only 2 stages with 1 5 the FLOPS of the first two stages of the author s model and runs 4 to 5 times faster on both cpu and gpu The prototxt of the training net and the solver can be found at https github com rocketbear pose estimation url Note that I have re implemented our customized data layer The affinity prediction and joint prediction shares all convolution feature maps i e there is only one branch up to the prediction output 3x3 conv is used in stage 2 but with more layers than the author s model Residual modules are used in both stage 1 and stage 2 The res module used in my model contains two 3x3 convolutions instead of 3x3 1x1 3x3 I have also tried mobilenet but failed to get a good model The training loss stopped at 310 for my 2 stage model using mobilenet so it would be around 1000 if all 6 stages are included which is similar to Ai is light s result The model is trained from scratch with batch size 40 all weights are initialized with Gaussian std 0 01 and all biases are initialized to 0 The initial learning rate is 1e 4 and is divided by 10 every 100k iterations The training loss converges to about 185 after 300k iterations If 4 more stages were added like the author s 6 stage model the training loss should be around 500 since the later stages should have lower loss than the earlier stages I have not evaluate the accuracy on the COCO dataset yet but the results on several sample images look similar to that generated by the first two stages of the author s model

title: Extract bounding box as well of the person out of the code
body: I am using your Matlab demo I skimmed through the code and It appeared to me that the code in its given form does not output bounding box of a person I understand one could compose the box out of key points but I was wondering if it is possible through the original code to get the bounding box of a person as well Regards

comments.body: We didn t try that before but it will be easy to implement You can modify the following code to do that after running candidates subset connect56LineVec oriImg final score param vis It has two for loops to go over each person subset and each part joint of that person for ridxPred 1 size subset 1 for part 1 14 index subset ridxPred part if index 0 x candidates index 1 y candidates index 2 update max x min y update max y min y end end end

title: A confused question in the data_transformer.cpp
body: I have read your paper but I have a question when I check the training source code caffe train In generateLabelMap line between 1840 and 1856 it seems count used in putVecMaps always is zero Mat

comments.body: The count is used for cross over situation e g if two left legs overlapping with each other then in the overlapping area each pixel will have two direction vectors from the two legs This situation rarely occurs and the count is mostly zero mat
